How Locked-On works

Assess first. Simplify where possible. Build what the organization can actually sustain.

The goal is not to add technology for its own sake. The goal is a secure, understandable environment that supports the way the organization needs to operate.

01 / DISCOVER

Understand the environment

Inventory systems, users, pain points, dependencies, risks and business requirements.

02 / DESIGN

Build the practical plan

Prioritize changes, architecture, migration sequence, security, costs and responsibilities.

03 / IMPLEMENT

Execute in controlled phases

Configure, migrate, integrate, test and communicate with minimum disruption.

04 / STABILIZE

Document and improve

Validate, train, document, monitor and refine the environment after cutover.
